reviews.comment:
Mal mal mal ....desde que entras hasta que salís te tratan mal pura mala atención, no les podes preguntar nada, parece que les  estás haciendo un favor , a el último tipo que me atendió debería haberlo  denunciado por insultarme , pero estaba con mí familia y no iba a permitir que me arruine el viaje......todo muy lindo y pintado pero cuándo los que empleados no sirven !!!! Auditoría urgente.

(Translated by Google)
Terrible, terrible, terrible... From the moment you walk in until you leave, they treat you badly, the service is awful. You can't ask them anything; it's like you're doing them a favor. I should have reported the last guy who served me for insulting me, but I was with my family and I wasn't going to let him ruin my trip. Everything looks great, but when the employees are useless, they're useless! An audit is urgently needed.
